subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Similarity and Enlargement

outcomes.text: determine the centre of enlargement and the linear scale factor of similar figures,
draw the image of an object given the centre of enlargement and the linear scale factor,
determine the area scale factor of similar figures,
determine the volume scale factor of similar objects,
relate linear scale factor to area and volume scale factor of similar objects,
apply similarity and enlargement to real-life situations,
appreciate the use of similarity and enlargement in real-life situations.

content: Enlargement Scale Factors (Linear, Area and Volume) (Negative scale factor will not be included)
inquiry_questions: How is similarity and enlargement applied in real life?
coreCompetencies:
Digital literacy: The learner develops the skills of connecting and interacting with digital technology when using digital resources to learn more on the use and application of similarity and enlargement.
Creativity and Imagination: the learner acquires networking skills when drawing images of given objects under a particular enlargement scale factor.
values: Responsibility: The learner takes care of objects collected from the immediate environment.
pcis: Environment and technology: the learner acquires the skill of sorting in managing the environment after collecting and sorting the objects and containers.
transcription_policy: Source wording retained,bullets/line breaks normalised;source pixels are authority.
notes: Negative scale factors explicitly excluded;positive fractional shrinkage is allowed.
Project continuation on page11:make similar cube,cuboid and cylinder containers;document measurements/challenges and take/save project images/video when devices permit.
Suggested experience repeats the same image-area ratio bullet twice;do not silently infer a different requirement.
